concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-risk-and-security-compliance-data-protection-laws]] - 2026-09-16 collected Braintree privacy and data-protection orientation covering its countries-of-operation compliance assertions, employee and privacy-officer responsibilities, basic controller/processor definitions, and provider-stated controller accountability for merchant and customer personal data; historical provider guidance, not current law, legal advice, a universal role allocation, account-specific determination, compliance certification or incident-response proof
warnings: Keep the reciprocal entry source- and snapshot-qualified; the article does not enumerate jurisdictions, laws, account types or processing activities and cannot establish the legal role for every data flow.
